title: Senior Protocol Lead
description:
Unlock the next era of public blockchain networks

About us 
We’re building Predicate, a platform setting the standard for how regulated blockchain applications enforce transaction rules at the smart contract layer. Predicate empowers teams to create modular, programmable policies—such as AML/CFT checks or offchain collateral requirements—that are verified before a transaction executes onchain. Our system enforces these policies with cryptographic guarantees, providing robust, scalable risk management tailored to real-world use cases.

The role 

As Protocol Lead, you’ll own the design, development, and maintenance of Predicate’s onchain suite. You’ll build tooling to support integrations, contribute to core infrastructure, and research emerging technologies to keep us at the forefront of the industry. You’ll also serve as the team’s blockchain subject matter expert, supporting teammates across the stack on all things related to blockchain interactions.

Responsibilities

  • Own the architecture, development, and maintenance of Predicate’s core smart contracts

  • Support customers integrating Predicate at the smart contract level

  • Deeply understand and add Predicate support for non-EVM chains

  • Iterate on the Predicate SDK and relevant documentation to supply a strong integration experience

  • Collaborate with the rest of the engineering team in Go and TypeScript on blockchain facing technology

What we look for

  • 5+ years of experience in software engineering

  • 2+ years of experience in Solidity development

  • Deep familiarity with the Solidity, Rust, and other relevant emerging tools

  • Strong familiarity with Golang and/or Typescript

  • Strong communication skills and comfort working with external partners/customers

  • Curiosity, initiative, and a drive to ship high-quality systems

Perks

  • Unlimited PTO with a high level of autonomy for your work

  • Best-in-class health, dental and vision insurance

  • Bi-annually world-wide team offsites

Compensation

We are committed to hiring the best talent, and that is reflected in our salary, equity compensation, and culture.
